content.title: Rework library E2E suite for per-test ephemeral worktree isolation
content.description:
The library E2E suite in tests e2e spawns the agt binary as a subprocess against the shared validation worktree dir. Tests must run serially (bun --jobs 1) and fail when validation state is polluted by prior runs. The releaser excluded the e2e dir from the publish-gate coverage command and added a serial test:e2e script as a stop-gap (accepted in review mqiax842ch item 3). This issue covers the real isolation fix.

Scope:
- Each e2e test must spin up its own unique ephemeral worktree using fs.mkdtemp under the OS tmpdir, never writing to the shared validation dir.
- Point the subprocess at the worktree via the AGENTRACK_CWD env var (verify the CLI respects it; if not, that is a prerequisite task to file separately).
- Add an afterEach (or per-test finally) cleanup that removes the ephemeral worktree so no state leaks between runs.
- Remove the serial-execution requirement once tests are isolated (verify they pass with default parallelism). Keep the test:e2e script as a convenience entrypoint.
- Add a small README note in the e2e folder documenting the isolation contract for future test authors.

Risk: medium. Subprocess and fs cleanup are the main sources of flake; consider a timeout-wrapper around spawn and a best-effort cleanup that swallows ENOENT. Verify the suite passes 3 times in a row on a clean checkout.

Parent context: review mqiax842ch item 3. Origin: idea mqh1l5phtj found during release prep mqe2xmprgj.

content.content:
Planned as a chore (test-infrastructure rework, no new user-facing capability). Architect direction already on record in review mqiax842ch item 3 (per-test fs.mkdtemp under OS tmpdir, AGENTRACK_CWD env var, afterEach cleanup, drop serial requirement). Broken into the standard 4 phase tasks under library team:

- mqibo59t45  Plan  → library-developer (investigate AGENTRACK_CWD support; if the CLI does NOT respect it, file a separate prerequisite chore and block this issue on it before implementation)
- mqibocc1kd  Dev    → library-developer  (blocked by Plan)
- mqibohp1zk  Validate → library-validator  (blocked by Dev; verify 3 consecutive clean parallel runs, no state leak, cleanup swallows ENOENT, spawn timeout-wrapper)
- mqiboor9kc  Release  → library-releaser   (blocked by Validate; decide publish-gate re-inclusion of e2e dir and drop the --jobs 1 serial requirement from test:e2e script)

Parent stays at todo — status loop promotes it when Dev starts. Stop-gap from release prep mqe2xmprgj remains in place until Release task lands.
